heading: Built for Learning. Designed for Growth.
subheading: Modern infrastructure created to provide an inspiring, distraction-free environment.

items.title: Acoustically Balanced Classrooms
items.description: Spacious, well-ventilated, and naturally lit lecture halls equipped with modern visual teaching aids for optimal student engagement.

items.title: Dedicated Science Laboratories
items.description: Separate Physics, Chemistry, and Biology laboratories equipped with modern apparatus, safety standards, and individual workstations.

items.title: Digital Technology Center
items.description: High-speed networked computer facility supporting digital academic research, online assessments, and computer literacy sessions.

items.title: Curated Knowledge Library
items.description: Extensive collection of reference volumes, textbooks, national journals, and quiet individual reading zones.

items.title: Sports Grounds & Playfields
items.description: Dedicated outdoor playfields and indoor activity spaces designed for daily sports drills, athletics, and recreational games.

items.title: Hygienic Dining Facility
items.description: Clean, spacious dining hall serving balanced, wholesome, and nutritious vegetarian meals prepared with high hygiene standards.
